displayName: NBD Pro — Firestore query needs a missing index (FAILED_PRECONDITION)

documentation.content:
A Cloud Function ran a Firestore query that needs a composite (or collection-group single-field) index that firestore.indexes.json does not define. Firestore rejects it with FAILED_PRECONDITION ('The query requires an index. You can create it here: …').

The emulator NEVER enforces indexes, so this passes every unit test, emulator suite and E2E shard and fails only in production — usually inside a try/catch that turns it into an empty list (callWatch, 2026-10-02).

Fix:
  1. Open the log entry; the message carries the console link with the exact index.
  2. Add that index to firestore.indexes.json (scope COLLECTION vs COLLECTION_GROUP matters).
  3. Run node scripts/check-firestore-indexes.js — if it did not flag this query, extend the scanner or tests/firestore-index-coverage-2026-10-04.test.js so the next one is caught before merge.
  4. Merge; the deploy's 'Deploy Firestore indexes' step builds it (minutes for small collections).

Also fires during the build window right after an index is added — expected, and stops once the index is READY.

Runbook: documentation/runbooks/FIRESTORE-INDEX-COVERAGE.md. Written 2026-10-04, NOT YET CREATED in Cloud Monitoring.

conditions.displayName: Firestore FAILED_PRECONDITION: query requires an index (any function; notifies at most hourly)

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND severity>=WARNING AND ("FAILED_PRECONDITION" OR "failed-precondition") AND "requires an index"
